landingCategories.title: What we buy
landingCategories.lead: These categories, for now. Each one asks for the details that actually matter for a fair offer.

noHaggling.title: No haggling with strangers
noHaggling.text: No ads to post, no messages at 11 p.m. You deal with a single buyer.

pickup.title: We pick it up
pickup.text: We arrange a pickup at your place or, if you prefer, you ship it.

chat.title: All over chat
chat.text: Questions, extra photos and pickup details, in one place and in real time.

payment.title: Paid to your account
payment.text: We pay you by bank transfer once we receive the item. No cash.

what.a: Tech, musical instruments, bikes and mobility, and photography. It must be yours, work (or be clearly listed for parts) and be original.

price.q: How do you decide what to offer?
price.a: We look at condition, brand, model and demand. That's why each category asks for its own details: good information means a fairer offer.

time.q: How long until I get an offer?
time.a: We review listings in order. You'll be notified in the app and in the notification bell as soon as you have an offer.

payment.a: By bank transfer to the account on your bank certificate, once we receive and check the item. That's why we ask you to complete your profile before accepting.

documents.a: Only the Trueke team handling your sale. They're kept in private storage, with no public links.

cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel the listing while it's in review or decline the offer. Nothing is final until you accept.
